# LongCat 2.5 (1.6T-A48B)

Meituan · released 2026-11

Open BF16 weights on HF (meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.5, repo created 2026-11-04, 3,562 GB) plus Meituan's W4A4 export (meituan-longcat/LongCat-2.5-W4A4, 1,336 GB, INT4 experts for domestic accelerators; same card). API: LongCat API change log 'Version: 2026-11-02 - LongCat-2.5 Now Available'; distinct from LongCat-2.5-Preview (API only, 2026-09-25). Native multimodal (image input), hybrid thinking/non-thinking. The card's only deployment route is NPU via SGLang-FluentLLM (longcat-2.5-npu branch); no GPU or consumer command and no official Ollama/GGUF entry (ollama.com/library/longcat-2.5 404), so local is null. API price: Pricing page observed 2026-11-12 shows only a limited-time discounted price (US$0.30 uncached input / US$1.20 output per 1M tokens) and no standard list price, so no price recorded.
